root_cause_analysis.finding: Da kiem tra 1 mau CWE-78 ro rang (subprocess.call voi shell=True) bi doan sai thanh SAFE.
root_cause_analysis.conclusion: Model khong 'mu' ve pattern (xac suat CWE-78 van dang ke, 0.33), nhung decision boundary bi lech ve phia SAFE do SAFE chiem ty le lon trong tap train (56%). Voi du lieu OOD (von kho hon, xa phan phoi train), nhieu truong hop bien bi day sang SAFE.

notes: Day la minh chung cho 'khoang trong tri thuc' da neu trong de cuong (muc 1.3): mo hinh hoc tu du lieu va loi thuc te (CVEfixes) kho tong quat hoa sang code co phong cach khac (OOD, do AI sinh hoac viet theo prompt).
CWE-22 va CWE-79 chi co rat it mau OOD (4 va 3) - danh gia mang tinh tham khao, khong du thong ke de ket luan chac chan.

Ket qua nay phu hop de dua vao chuong Ket qua nghien cuu, phan so sanh in-distribution vs out-of-distribution, cho thay han che thuc te cua he thong va huong cai thien trong tuong lai (vi du: dieu chinh threshold, hoac augment du lieu train voi code phong cach da dang hon).
